name: Area Play
author: NexArea
description:
A fast and good-looking game hub for PS Vita.
Your PS Vita, PSP and PS1 games, retro systems and homebrews in one place, with covers and backgrounds downloaded automatically.
Retro games launched directly with RetroArch, Emu4Vita++ or standalone emulators. Themes, 26 accent colours, wallpapers, replaceable icons and sounds, carousel / grid / list views, favourites, collections and instant search.
Touch screen and buttons. English and French.
Trailer: https://youtu.be/WNm3kU46JUY
requirements: HENkaku / Enso. Wi-Fi and TLS 1.2 for covers (firmware 3.73 or iTLS-Enso). Optional: RetroArch, Emu4Vita++, Adrenaline.
